detail_processing.implementation: LightCraft GPU detail pipeline, same shared worker for all engines
detail_processing.native_filters: Apple adjustable sharpness/detail/luminance NR/color NR set to zero where supported; LightCraft native sharpening/NR off; rawler has no default NR or sharpening edit
detail_processing.timing: sum of base-conversion and common-detail intervals; bridge file transport, IPC and checksums excluded for all three
detail_processing.working_space: sRGB RGBA8 decoded to linear Rec.2020 before common GPU filters; final sRGB RGBA8 readback
detail_processing.limitations: Controlled test, not native app defaults or an equal-quality claim. RAW color/tone rendering and baked-in camera processing can differ.
